notes: Cases for the capability gate that agents/evor-forge.md specifies under
<Check_Capability_And_Gotchas>. Every expectation here is derivable from
that section's three HARD RULES and nothing else — no property is graded
that the agent file does not already mandate.
The gate is the only part of forge's job with a derivable answer. The rest
of forge (spawning a team, materialising a genome, storing deltas) needs
live MCP state and a worktree, and is covered by ci/bench-tick.sh instead.
Three of the six cases expect proceed-with-no-change, so an agent that
always aborts scores 1/6 and one that always proceeds untouched scores
carry a real gotcha that must be read and rejected, not merely absent.

cases.note: Ampere GPU, no gotchas, ordinary proposal — nothing to gate on.

proposal.technique: cosine learning-rate schedule with 5-epoch linear warmup

cases.note: HARD RULE 1: cpu_only=True means the constraint is passed down to forge-junior. The proposal itself is CPU-runnable, so this is a proceed, not an abort.

proposal.technique: label smoothing 0.1 with a wider first conv block

cases.note: HARD RULE 2: a hardware-constraint gotcha whose signature matches the proposal's technique. Pascal card, flash-attention-2 proposal — the hardware cannot run this.

gotchas.signature: flash-attention-2 requires Ampere (sm_80) or newer; it does not build on Pascal

proposal.technique: replace the attention block with a flash-attention-2 kernel

cases.note: Negative control for HARD RULE 2: a high-confidence hardware-constraint gotcha is present but names a technique the proposal does not use. Aborting here would be a false positive.

gotchas.signature: 8-bit bitsandbytes optimizers require CUDA >= 11.8; this host ships 11.4

proposal.technique: mixup augmentation with alpha 0.2, plain fp32 SGD optimizer

cases.note: HARD RULE 3: a runtime-failure gotcha whose context.batch_size equals the proposal's batch_size on the SAME task. The known-safe batch_size (128) is passed down instead; the proposal is not aborted.

gotchas.signature: CUDA OOM at batch_size 512 on 16GB; batch_size 128 completed

proposal.technique: larger-batch training with a linearly scaled LR

cases.note: Negative control for HARD RULE 3: the same OOM gotcha is present, but the proposal asks for batch_size 64, which the gotcha does not name. Substituting 128 here would RAISE the batch size on the strength of an OOM report.

gotchas.signature: CUDA OOM at batch_size 512 on 16GB; batch_size 128 completed
